seo.title: Journeys — the great multi-city trips — TripAgent
seo.description: The great multi-city routes — Golden Triangle, Classic Japan, the Greek Isles and more, planned night by night by your advisor.

hero.heading: The great multi-city trips.
hero.lede: Routes worth taking as one trip. The right order, the right number of nights, planned with your advisor.

cards.body: The founding circuit of Indian travel, paced so no city is rushed and Agra is seen at dawn.
Four princely cities in descending scale, ending on the lake so the desert gives way to water.
From colonial port up to the tea hills and down to the still water, following the land as it descends.
Vale of Kashmir first, then the high desert of Ladakh, so the body climbs by degrees.
The capital, the old court city, and the kitchen of the nation, linked by the fastest train on earth.
The classic triangle, taken slowly — antiquity, the Renaissance, then the lagoon.
The eternal city first, then down to the cliffs to let the pace fall away.
A short city opening, then the water and mountains of Como.
A gentle arrival, the Matterhorn, then the light of the Engadine.
The city in full, then down to the sea and the light of the Côte d'Azur.
Mediterranean modernism, then the weight of the capital.
Antiquity first, then two islands with distinct tempers.
The city of two continents, then the quiet of the high plateau.
The light of the south, then the river and the wine.
The theatre of the new city, then the calmer, cultural capital.
City first, then a slow unwind west into the Andaman Sea.
The country read top to bottom, from northern mist to the Mekong's warmth.
cards.cities: Hanoi · Hoi An & Da Nang · Ho Chi Minh City

cards.body: A polished city overture before the island slows everything down.
A brief city start, then the fort towns and beaches of the south.
The plains of the Mara first, then the Indian Ocean to soften the landing.
Coast to high Andes, ending at the citadel above the clouds.
Pacific light and hills, then a night of the desert's excess.
cards.cities: San Francisco · Los Angeles · Las Vegas

cards.body: The city's pace, then warm water and slower days.
Harbour and headland, then the quiet confidence of the south.
A soft landing in the north, then the drama of the Southern Alps.
From the temple-dense valley of Nepal to the quiet, guarded kingdom next door.

cta.heading: A route in mind, or one all your own?
cta.lede: These are starting points. Your advisor sets the order, the nights and the pace to your dates — then holds the flights, the stays and the visas.
